objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact representing policies, guidelines, work instructions, or other organizational content subject to creation, editing, release, and archival processes.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification such as Policy, Guideline, Work Instruction, or Procedural Instruction.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state such as Editing, Review, Released, or Out of Force.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Numeric identifier tracking document revisions.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date when the document becomes effective.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date when the document expires and requires validity extension review.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Short code assigned to the document for identification.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to related master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Associated systems or software applications.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Area of validity or applicability.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document linked to a main document, subject to the same release cycle and versioning as the parent document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state synchronized with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Numeric identifier tracking attachment revisions.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary content attached to a document that is not subject to release cycle or formal approval.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the additional info is visible to readers.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A request to amend a released document without affecting the current version or release history.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State indicating whether the proposal is pending or completed.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: An automated or manual request to confirm a document's continued validity before expiration.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Processing state of the validity extension request.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A formal request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has valid applicability.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Processing state of the override request.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to restore and re-validate a previously archived or invalidated document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Processing state of the reactivation request.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person with assigned roles and permissions in the document management system.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Assigned function such as Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Reader, or Translator.

attributes.name: user_group
attributes.description: Collective assignment for authorization and distribution purposes.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned for coordinated authorization, distribution, or notification purposes.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier for the user group such as Reader or Archive group.

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Function of the group such as distribution or access control.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: An automated process governing document approval, validity extension, override, or reactivation with defined participant steps and decision logic.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Kind of workflow such as Release, Validity Extension, Override, or Reactivation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current execution state of the workflow.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A maintained set of users and user groups designated to receive documents or notifications.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Method such as Email Notification or Acknowledgement.

objs.name: archive
objs.description: A repository for invalidated or expired documents, maintaining read-only access for authorized archive group members during the defined archive duration.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period in years before physical deletion occurs.

objs.name: template
objs.description: A predefined document structure associated with a document type, supporting automated metadata injection and content formatting.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The document type to which the template applies.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature applied by workflow participants to authenticate and authorize document approval, review, or release actions.

attributes.name: participant
attributes.description: User who applied the signature.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of signature application.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Initiate a new document in the system with assignment of document type and optional template selection.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modify the substantive content of a document using integrated authoring tools and supported formats.

evts.name: maintain_document_metadata
evts.description: Define or update document properties such as references, scope, and validity dates in the system.

evts.name: submit_for_review
evts.description: Initiate the formal approval workflow by the document author, requesting designated reviewers to evaluate the document.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Conduct technical and formal evaluation of a document against defined criteria, resulting in approval or rejection.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Authorize publication of a reviewed document with electronic signature, making it available to designated readers.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Make a released document visible to authorized readers through the system, automatically triggered upon release.

evts.name: acknowledge_document
evts.description: Workflow-supported confirmation by a user that they have reviewed and accepted the obligation to follow a published document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Submit a planned amendment to a released document without modifying the current version or release history.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Process an approved change proposal by incorporating proposed modifications into a new document version.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: Link a controlled document to a main document, subjecting it to the parent's release and versioning cycle.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: Attach supplementary content to a document that operates independently of the release cycle.

evts.name: archive_additional_info
evts.description: Remove additional info from circulation while retaining it for historical reference.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Remove an attachment from circulation while marking it for archival, triggering a new main document version.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Create a new editing version of a released document with retained metadata, enabling updates and modifications.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirm continued applicability of a document, updating the valid until date by the standard period.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: Automatically or manually initiate a formal review of document validity before expiration.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Initiate a formal process to invalidate and withdraw a document from circulation due to loss of validity.

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: Complete the formal process of invalidating a document, revoking all user authorizations except for the archive group.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Initiate a request to restore and re-authorize a previously archived or invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Complete the process of restoring a previously invalidated document to active status with updated version control.

evts.name: assign_user_to_role
evts.description: Designate a user to perform a specific role on a document such as Author, Reviewer, Releaser, or Reader.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Notify assigned users and user groups of document release via email notification.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Request assigned users and user groups to actively confirm receipt and acceptance of a document through workflow-supported acknowledgement.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Define or update the users and user groups assigned to receive document distribution or acknowledgement notifications.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Create a language-dependent version of a released document content.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Evaluate a translated document version for accuracy and consistency, resulting in approval or rejection.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Authorize publication of a reviewed translation with electronic signature, making it available to readers in the target language.

evts.name: generate_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert edited document content to PDF format for web display and distribution.

evts.name: apply_electronic_signature
evts.description: Authenticate and authorize a workflow action with a digital signature by a designated participant.
